messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate for inference-runtime.eu-west-1 (~8% failure, spike at 17:14 UTC). Error class: SIGSEGV / kernel crash in quant_attention kernel. P50 latency normal. Tagged: production, high-severity.

maria.g: seeing it on Grafana too, 5xx spike from 17:13. Mostly small models (opt-2.7q).

kevin.s: oncall here. I’m pulling logs now. Any recent rollouts?

samira: no infra rollouts, but we had a canary push of quantized kernels earlier today around 12:30 UTC to improve perf. Eng-runtime, did that touch eu-west?

eng-runtime: yea that canary included an attention kernel variant that rolled out to 10% by 12:45 and to 50% yesterday. We pinned for canary traffic in eu-west. Investigating.

kevin.s: copying logs for a sample crash:
```
[2024-04-04T17:13:52Z] worker-12 SIGSEGV at 0x7f2a8f0: backtrace: quant_attention_v2+0x1f4
[2024-04-04T17:13:52Z] pid=23455 tid=23467 oom_kill: no
[2024-04-04T17:13:52Z] model=opt-2.7q seq_len=1024 batch=1
```

maria.g: pattern: segfault in quant attention, small models, not huge seq_len but consistent. Error rate concentrated on two host pools: eu-west-{a,b}.

oncall-sre: any customer-impacting alerts from CS?

customer-success: CS reports a handful of enterprise customers seeing increased 5xx on chat endpoints. Tickets low-sev but multiple duplicates. No major revenue customers on pager yet.

samira: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) route canary traffic away from quant_attention kernel on eu-west 2) increase fallback to fp16 kernel variant 3) scale up non-quant workers to absorb.

eng-runtime: we can flip routing flag to disable quant_attention_v2 in region within ~60s. Revert path exists. We should do that and hand off detailed debug to runtime team.

kevin.s: do the flip. Maria/Kevin will monitor. Also capture core dumps and attach to ticket.

eng-runtime: executing rollback flag now: `curl -X POST https://internal-config/api/flip -d '{"kernel":"quant_attention_v2","region":"eu-west","state":"off"}'` -> 202 Accepted.

deploy-bot: rollout change applied to eu-west routing (change id: R-20240404-17:14).

maria.g: visible drop in 5xx within 90s to 1.2% from 8%. Good. Keep monitoring for 10m.

kevin.s: collecting core dumps: commands posted to /tmp/incident-4132105678/ on worker nodes. Sample dump uploaded: `s3://redwood-incident-dumps/4132105678/worker-12-core.gz`

eng-runtime: grabbing debug symbols and reproducer. Requesting model and input trace from the failing worker - please do not purge logs.

samira: handoff: kevin taking live mitigation complete, eng-runtime owning root cause and revert remediation. Oncall-sre to monitor for regressions. CS to update customers with short note: we mitigated and are investigating root cause; ETA for RCA: 24-72h.

oncall-sre: confirmed monitoring alerts set to lower threshold. Will escalate if 5xx > 2% again.

customer-success: posting initial message to impacted customers: "We've rolled back a kernel variant that caused elevated errors in eu-west and request routing is stable. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with an RCA."

kevin.s: logging postmortem kickoff ticket INC-4132105678. Tags: segfault, quant-kernel, eu-west, rollback. Assign eng-runtime.

eng-runtime: tentative root cause hypothesis: race in quant_attention_v2 when kv-cache reuse hits alignment path for small models. Reproducer in progress. Will propose fix or full revert if reproducible.

maria.g: thanks team. Final note: customer impact limited but visible; mitigation success confirmed. Handing off live monitoring to oncall-sre for 24h. :thumbsup:
